entries.title: Clicking another Tasks row works while a card comes forward
entries.body: When you open a task from Tasks and at once click another row, the card you opened no longer takes the keyboard's place from Tasks, so the second click opens its task.
entries.noPicture: A rare ordering of two clicks; the screens look the same before and after once it is gone.

entries.title: A summary no longer stays open after you move away
entries.body: Moving the pointer off a crewmate, a Tasks row or a task key just as its summary was due to open could leave the summary showing with nothing pointed at. It now opens only while you still rest there.
entries.noPicture: Moving the pointer away at the moment a summary opens cannot show in a still picture.
